criteria.use_switch: Use a switch or call, board and ride a lift to unlock the route.
criteria.exit: Go to the exit and finish the level.
criteria.explore: Explore accessible areas for another route.
criteria.look_back: Turn clockwise 180 degrees to inspect behind you. Do not walk or fire. Stop after the half turn.

item.instructions: Choose a useful item. Get needed health, a stronger gun, ammunition for an empty gun, or a required key. Avoid unnecessary pickups.

switch.instructions: Choose the mechanism that advances the route. Continue boarding or riding the current lift. Activate unused door switches; get missing keys.

criteria.728: Call, board and ride lift #728 to the upper floor. Phase: call. Distance 68.9m. Upper route keys: red (collected).
criteria.805: Call, board and ride lift #805 to the upper floor. Phase: call. Distance 11.6m. Upper route keys: blue (collected).

weapon.instructions: Choose an effective weapon. Use a loaded gun for ranged enemies. Prefer shotgun to pistol when both are loaded. Use melee when there is no usable gun. Prefer a loaded super shotgun to the ordinary shotgun.

criteria.melee: Melee only, range 1.5m. Loaded: yes. Can hit visible enemies from here: no. Ammo: 0.
criteria.pistol: Basic ranged gun. Loaded: yes. Can hit visible enemies from here: no. Ammo: 65.
criteria.shotgun: Powerful ranged gun. Loaded: yes. Can hit visible enemies from here: no. Ammo: 8.
criteria.super_shotgun: Super shotgun: stronger than the shotgun, uses two shells. Loaded: yes. Can hit visible enemies from here: no. Ammo: 8.

combat.instructions: Choose an enemy to aim at while executing the selected navigation command, or hold. Recently seen enemies may be aimed at; fire only when they are visible. Keep following the selected route.

criteria.hold: Do not fire while executing the selected navigation command.
